title: DocsTopic
description: One topic-sized answer from `docs(query)` (RFC §5.2.2). A query returns what was asked for and nothing more: `docs` MUST NOT return the full reference in a single call, and breadth belongs in the index and in `see_also`, never in the payload. Size is not expressible in JSON Schema; the token ceiling is enforced by the budget harness (CC5).

topic.description: The topic name, matching the name carried in the index.

summary.description: The answer, written for an agent: dense, correct, example-first.

examples.description: Worked examples. A topic SHOULD show, in its examples, the twin produced when the operation is misused, so the error and the doc recognize each other (RFC §5.2.4).

see_also.description: Related topic names. Pointers, not payload.
